column1: # platform_hooks.tsv: the functions the L6 device layer (render/d3d9/dev) CALLS and the PLATFORM defines (guest: L5 platform / L1; tests: the harness). The product objects leave them undefined on purpose; this file is the request to the platform lead.

# columns (tab separated): name, C++ signature, required semantics (one line), Win32 fact it carries. Declarations: glue_stream.h (gpu_*), copy_util.h (dc_*), dev_hooks.h (window_client, perf_counter, os_cursor_pos).

column2: uint64_t nxd3d_gpu_call(uint32_t fn, const uint64_t* args, uint32_t nargs)
column3: guest: ext_call(NXGPU_EXT_MODULE, fn, args, nargs) into the GPU backend (nxgpu4.h, fn < NXGPU_FN_COUNT4); returns the backend's uint64_t unchanged (NXGPU_BAD_CALL = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF02); every address in args or in a struct a call points to is nxd3d_gpu_alloc memory
column4: none (the console GPU backend: deko3d through host module 10; the Win32 device is D3D9 itself)

column3: memory the GPU backend may read and write, 4 KiB aligned, bytes a multiple of 4 KiB (the caller rounds), contents unspecified; NULL when none is left (callers return D3DERR_OUTOFVIDEOMEMORY / E_OUTOFMEMORY, never dereference)
column4: D3D9 video memory (resources in D3DPOOL_DEFAULT / the driver's command buffers)

column3: releases a block of nxd3d_gpu_alloc (never null from the glue except where a null check is stated); the backend no longer references it when the call is made

column2: void* nxd3d_dc_create(void* mem, uint32_t d3dfmt, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t pitch)
column3: a memory device context whose bitmap IS mem (rows pitch bytes apart, top row first); d3dfmt in {A8R8G8B8, X8R8G8B8, R5G6B5, X1R5G5B5, A1R5G5B5, R8G8B8}; writes through the DC land in mem; NULL = cannot
destroys a DC made by nxd3d_dc_create; the pixels stay in mem

false iff hwnd is not a window (IsWindow == FALSE, including NULL); else *r (r may be null) = the client area in SCREEN coordinates {left, top, right, bottom}; the presented image of a chain is exactly this area (the backend's swapchain image has its size)
returns the monotonic counter, *freq = ticks per second (> 0); used for GetRasterStatus (Wine wined3d_output_get_raster_status derives the scan line from it)
the cursor position in screen coordinates (the last known one when the pointer left); used when ShowCursor makes the device cursor visible
writes one log line naming a row of verify/wine_fixme.tsv and returns (loader/include/fnvnx_reach.h, L1)

the declared machine's profile, NX_ENV_HANDHELD or NX_ENV_DOCKED (the console's mode: handheld 1280x720, docked 1920x1080); constant for the life of the process; the adapter answers all environment queries (adapter identifier, caps, formats, modes) from the table of this profile (owner: L5 platform, declared machine)
column4: the machine's display configuration (EnumDisplaySettings / the adapter the driver reports); no Win32 call: the profile selects the declared-machine row set
